name: demo_story
description: SYNTHETIC scripted demo (spec section 10). Headlines are invented for the demo and are labelled SYNTHETIC everywhere; they imitate the style of real sources only to pick a credibility prior. Sequence: (1) low-risk positive product launch at a small held US issuer, seen on social media -> low impact, no trigger; (2) credit downgrade + regulatory probe at a held issuer -> idiosyncratic stress; (3) market-wide geopolitical shock reported by a news wire and then corroborated by a second, independent source -> systemic stress.
